subject: Vector-store interop: runbook & certification request (Pinecone / S3 / Weaviate)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@pinecone.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@atlasdata.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: interop test & cert request (Pinecone <> Redwood)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the intro earlier this quarter — Samira from Pinecone here. We ran a short pilot with a mutual customer and saw a couple of interesting edge cases where S3 fallthrough + index mirroring caused query mismatch on cold shards. The customer asked whether we can provide a "partner-certified" runbook that outlines:

- expected routing (pgvector vs Pinecone vs S3)
- SLOs for read/replicate traffic during failover
- steps to validate prefix/KV caching after a restore

Can Redwood share your runbook template and a lightweight certification checklist? If you have a short intake spreadsheet we can fill with the sample dataset size, retention policy, and a staging endpoint, that would speed things up.

We'd like to propose a joint interop smoke test next week and then publish a short "integration note" on both partner docs sites. High level ask: 2-week timeline from intake to smoke test.

I attached a short summary from our ops team and an example test plan. Happy to jump on a 30-min tech sync if that helps.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Partnerships, Pinecone
attachment: pinecone_ops_summary.pdf (summary)
attachment: pinecone_test_plan.md (test plan)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pinecone.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: interop test & cert request (Pinecone <> Redwood)

Hi Samira — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear ask. We're keen to get this validated. Looping in Vanessa (partnerships lead), Ben (eng), and Connor (ops) to scope the work.

Immediate next steps I propose:

1) You fill the intake grid (minimal): dataset size, typical vec dims, retention, and whether you need write-through or read-only replication. I attached our intake template and a short runbook scaffold (redwood_runbook_template.md + interop_checklist.xlsx).

2) We'll schedule a 30-min tech sync with Ben + Connor to align on staging endpoints and test harness (please propose 3 slots).

3) Within 10 business days we aim for: runbook v0 + smoke test on a small sample (<= 1M vectors) and a short integration note. If the smoke test surfaces issues we will triage and propose mitigations (routing rules / cache warmers / TTL changes).

A few clarifying Qs for your intake:
- Do you expect cold-shard reads to be redirected to S3 in your current customer config, or do you plan to mirror into an actively-served Pinecone index?
- Any regulatory constraints (EU data residency) for this customer?

I'll be out Wednesday afternoon but team will cover. Vanessa — can you help own the partner-facing comms and the public integration note? Ben/Connor — can you review the runbook template and call out any missing testcases we should add (KV cache restore, partial index rebuild, query-time consistency checks)?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
attachment: redwood_runbook_template.md (runbook scaffold)
attachment: interop_checklist.xlsx (intake grid)

Subject: Fwd: Quick: interop test & cert request (Pinecone <> Redwood)

Folks — forwarding Pinecone's ask. Internal notes / priorities below. Please keep replies brief so we can move quickly.

Ben (eng): prioritize these testcases in the runbook review:
- cache restore validation (we must verify KV cache validity across replicas)
- fallback routing logic when primary Pinecone index is stale (how we decide to hit S3)
- measuring token/response latency impact for mixed-read traffic

Connor (ops): help define the staging environment (s3 bucket + sample prefix) and where we can observe reads/writes. Estimate infra hours?

Vanessa (partnerships): draft a 1-paragraph partner note for our docs post-test (we'll iterate with Pinecone).

Targets: intake filled today, tech sync tomorrow (10–11am PT preferred), runbook v0 within 5 business days, smoke test within 10 business days. If we need an exception to reserved capacity or extra burst credit for the smoke test, call it out here (we can escalate).

Quick replies only — add key blockers.

— Steph
